replies.author: @Globallife.documentary
replies.text: It is possible, but legal residency requires a formal route like employer sponsorship, academic study, or marriage. Because navigating Israeli bureaucracy and the high cost of living can be challenging, many people start with an extended stay, an internship, or a volunteer program to build local connections and see if the pace and culture truly suit them. Definitely worth researching the B/1 work visa or student exchange pathways!
